## 4 Reasons + Why our products are good for you

## We are scientist engaged in 144+ mushroom research papers

For example, a beneficial ingredient of Lion’s Mane is “Hericenone.” Please check Wikipedia of
Lion’s Mane or Google it. You will see it there. We were involved in this study and research. Now,
we are the only one who can extract and label this specific ingredient. Other companies only use
powder or mere extract that is not clear if it really contains “Hericenone.”

[ READ MORE][14]

## Extract meaningful ingredients of research papers OUT FROM regular extract

“Hericenone”, “Amyloban”, “Maitake D Fraction”, “Maitake SX Fraction”. Please google these
beneficial ingredients. You will be amazed. They are the exact beneficial ingredients in research
papers. We extract and label them while others CANNOT. We extract the specific extract OUT OF
regular extract which are in research papers. Our extract is not a mere extract.

[ READ MORE][15]

## No trick by mycelium. We use Fruiting body.

At Mushroom Wisdom, we base our processes on extensive research into the fruiting body. Is the
benefit you want supported by a mycelium study or a fruiting body study? Does the supplement
manufacturer make the difference clear to you, as a consumer?

[ READ MORE][16]

## 30+ Years of Experience

We have spent decades researching our products. We know the beneficial properties, and how to
extract and concentrate specific ingredients. Our approach is so different that we hold many patents
for our work. We have been studying mushrooms since 1991, and have specialized, patented processes.

[ READ MORE][17]

## Fruit body "EXTRACT". Not mere mushroom powder

The FDA restricts supplement manufacturers from selling mycelium grown in acceptable media for food
use to be listed as containing mushrooms. To get around this restriction, many supplement producers
simply mix ground mushroom into a myceliated grain products. How much benefit is actually found in
these products? You deserve to know.

[ READ MORE][18]

## We have been working with other Scientists

Georgetown University, New York Medical College, Indiana University School of Medicine, Tufts
University, Shizuoka University (Japan), KURUME University of Medicine (Japan), Chiba University
Center for Forensic Mental Health (Japan), Osaka Prefecture University (Japan)…

[ READ MORE][19]

## 70,000 tons Mushroom Production per Year, 30+Researchers

MUSHROOM WISDOM is a group company of Hokuto Corporation which has devoted over a half a century to
researching the health benefits of mushrooms in Japan. It is the largest mushroom company in the
country, with more than 1,000 employees, and producing more than 70,000 tons of mushrooms yearly, in
over 30 mushroom growing facilities.

[ READ MORE][20]

#### ABOUT

# Mushroom Wisdom

Founded in 1991, Mushroom Wisdom has flourished into a global leader in the development, production
and research of mushroom supplements. Starting with what was previously a not well-known mushroom in
the West, namely Maitake, we have grown into a line of different mushroom products including 11
different mushrooms, three unique research-grounded proprietary extracts, and even a topical
moisturizing skin cream.

The selection of the word “wisdom” in the company’s name was not an accident, Mushroom Wisdom has
been and continues to be fully committed and a leader in the use of mushrooms to support and promote
our health and well-being.* We have sponsored scientific research in cooperation with prominent
universities and medical centers.

The motto “Science Complementing Ancient Wisdom” encapsulates Mushroom Wisdom’s commitment to
honoring tradition while uniting it with modern science and research. With this in mind, we welcome
you to explore the wonderful world of Mushroom Wisdom.

*These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. These products are
not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease.

[READ MORE][21]

## FAQs

#### [How do I take your products?][29]

Our suggested directions are on a label of each product. We do not have particular directions on the
best time of the day to take our products. It is a personal preference because everyone is unique in
how they react to each supplement. It can be taken with food. For further guidance, please consult
your healthcare physician.

#### [How does heat affect the activity or health benefits of the products?][30]

Our mushroom ingredients have been extracted with hot water and/or alcohol. Therefore, hot water and
heat under life environment will not affect the quality of our products.

#### [Do I need to take your product daily?][31]

We recommend take our products daily. Daily supplement usage will support long-term benefits. For
further guidance, please consult your healthcare physician.

#### [What is the best time of day to take your products?][32]

We do not have particular directions on the best time of the day to take our products. You can take
our products any time during the day. It is a personal preference because everyone is unique in how
they react to each supplement. It can be taken with food. For further guidance, please consult your
health care physician.

## 4 Reasons + Why our products are good for you

## We are scientist engaged in 144+ mushroom research papers

For example, a beneficial ingredient of Lion’s Mane is “Hericenone.” Please check Wikipedia of
Lion’s Mane or Google it. You will see it there. We were involved in this study and research. Now,
we are the only one who can extract and label this specific ingredient. Other companies only use
powder or mere extract that is not clear if it really contains “Hericenone.”

[ READ MORE][14]

## Extract meaningful ingredients of research papers OUT FROM regular extract

“Hericenone”, “Amyloban”, “Maitake D Fraction”, “Maitake SX Fraction”. Please google these
beneficial ingredients. You will be amazed. They are the exact beneficial ingredients in research
papers. We extract and label them while others CANNOT. We extract the specific extract OUT OF
regular extract which are in research papers. Our extract is not a mere extract.

[ READ MORE][15]

## No trick by mycelium. We use Fruiting body.

At Mushroom Wisdom, we base our processes on extensive research into the fruiting body. Is the
benefit you want supported by a mycelium study or a fruiting body study? Does the supplement
manufacturer make the difference clear to you, as a consumer?

[ READ MORE][16]

## 30+ Years of Experience

We have spent decades researching our products. We know the beneficial properties, and how to
extract and concentrate specific ingredients. Our approach is so different that we hold many patents
for our work. We have been studying mushrooms since 1991, and have specialized, patented processes.

[ READ MORE][17]

## Fruit body "EXTRACT". Not mere mushroom powder

The FDA restricts supplement manufacturers from selling mycelium grown in acceptable media for food
use to be listed as containing mushrooms. To get around this restriction, many supplement producers
simply mix ground mushroom into a myceliated grain products. How much benefit is actually found in
these products? You deserve to know.

[ READ MORE][18]

## We have been working with other Scientists

Georgetown University, New York Medical College, Indiana University School of Medicine, Tufts
University, Shizuoka University (Japan), KURUME University of Medicine (Japan), Chiba University
Center for Forensic Mental Health (Japan), Osaka Prefecture University (Japan)…

[ READ MORE][19]

## 70,000 tons Mushroom Production per Year, 30+Researchers

MUSHROOM WISDOM is a group company of Hokuto Corporation which has devoted over a half a century to
researching the health benefits of mushrooms in Japan. It is the largest mushroom company in the
country, with more than 1,000 employees, and producing more than 70,000 tons of mushrooms yearly, in
over 30 mushroom growing facilities.

[ READ MORE][20]

#### ABOUT

# Mushroom Wisdom

Founded in 1991, Mushroom Wisdom has flourished into a global leader in the development, production
and research of mushroom supplements. Starting with what was previously a not well-known mushroom in
the West, namely Maitake, we have grown into a line of different mushroom products including 11
different mushrooms, three unique research-grounded proprietary extracts, and even a topical
moisturizing skin cream.

The selection of the word “wisdom” in the company’s name was not an accident, Mushroom Wisdom has
been and continues to be fully committed and a leader in the use of mushrooms to support and promote
our health and well-being.* We have sponsored scientific research in cooperation with prominent
universities and medical centers.

The motto “Science Complementing Ancient Wisdom” encapsulates Mushroom Wisdom’s commitment to
honoring tradition while uniting it with modern science and research. With this in mind, we welcome
you to explore the wonderful world of Mushroom Wisdom.

*These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. These products are
not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease.

## FAQs

#### [How do I take your products?][29]

Our suggested directions are on a label of each product. We do not have particular directions on the
best time of the day to take our products. It is a personal preference because everyone is unique in
how they react to each supplement. It can be taken with food. For further guidance, please consult
your healthcare physician.

#### [How does heat affect the activity or health benefits of the products?][30]

Our mushroom ingredients have been extracted with hot water and/or alcohol. Therefore, hot water and
heat under life environment will not affect the quality of our products.

#### [Do I need to take your product daily?][31]

We recommend take our products daily. Daily supplement usage will support long-term benefits. For
further guidance, please consult your healthcare physician.

#### [What is the best time of day to take your products?][32]

We do not have particular directions on the best time of the day to take our products. You can take
our products any time during the day. It is a personal preference because everyone is unique in how
they react to each supplement. It can be taken with food. For further guidance, please consult your
health care physician.

# Cold-Climate Septic Systems for Bangor Homes

permitted through the Penobscot County health department. Free site evaluations across the Bangor
area.

* Free site evaluations

* Penobscot County permits

## Maine Septic Field Notes

Cold-climate installation insights for homeowners dealing with Maine frost and high water tables.

### [Planning a Septic Install Around Maine Frost and Water Tables][10]

July 1, 2026

[Septic system trench dug for a Bangor, ME install]

Installing a septic system in Bangor is not the same job it would be in a warmer state. Deep frost,
a short building window, and water tables that climb every spring all shape what will actually pass
and last here. If you are planning a new system or replacing a failed one, here is what to keep in
mind before the first shovel goes in.

### Respect the Frost Line

The frost line in Penobscot County runs close to four feet, and that number drives the whole design.
Tanks, supply lines, and the drainfield have to sit deep enough that the system keeps flowing when
the ground above it is frozen solid in January. Gasketed risers bring the access lids back up near
grade so you are not digging through frozen earth to pump the tank later.

### Test the Water Table, Not Just the Soil

A perc test tells you how fast the soil drains, but the seasonal high water table is what sinks a
lot of Maine drainfields. Ground that looks dry in August can be saturated in April when the
snowpack melts. The design has to keep four feet of vertical separation between the bottom of the
field and that high water mark, which is exactly why we check both during a [drainfield
installation][11] evaluation.

### Know When a Standard System Will Not Pass

On lots with heavy clay, shallow bedrock, or a persistently high water table, a conventional gravity
drainfield will not clear the county requirements. That is when an engineered mound or an aerobic
treatment unit earns its cost, lifting the treatment area so the separation is met. Finding this out
at the perc stage, before you have committed to a layout, saves real money.

### Build in the Right Season

Frozen surface soil makes an excavation slower and more expensive to keep open, so timing matters.
Many Bangor installs are best scheduled for the shoulder seasons, late spring through fall, when the
ground is workable and the schedule is predictable. Planning ahead means you are not stuck waiting
on a failed system in the middle of winter.

### Keep Up With Pumping

Once the system is in, the cheapest insurance is regular pumping. The EPA guidance is every three to
five years, which clears the sludge and scum before solids reach the field. A failed drainfield is
the costliest repair on the property, and routine service is what prevents it.

Every lot is different, and the only way to plan a system that fits yours is a real site evaluation.
If you have questions about a new install, a replacement, or a field that is showing trouble,
[contact us][12] or call Arclightscope at **(207) 567-6051** for a free evaluation in the Bangor
area.

[Read the full article][13]

### Installing Septic Systems in Maine's Freeze-Thaw Climate

One local crew for every part of an onsite wastewater system, engineered for the freeze-thaw cycle
that defines a Bangor install.
* ### New Septic System Installation
  
  Full design and install of the tank, distribution box, and drainfield, sized from bedroom count. A
  typical three bedroom home takes a 1,000 to 1,250 gallon tank set below the frost line.
* ### Septic Tank Replacement
  
  Removal of a failed or cracked tank and set of a new watertight concrete, polyethylene, or
  fiberglass unit, most often a 1,000 to 1,500 gallon tank matched to your household.
* ### Drainfield and Leach Field Installation
  
  Gravel trench or plastic chamber fields sized from the perc rate, built with enough separation to
  the seasonal water table that treated effluent disperses without surfacing.
* ### Aerobic Treatment Units
  
  Oxygen fed advanced units certified to NSF/ANSI Standard 40, a strong fit for small lots or the
  tight, poorly draining soils common on older Bangor parcels.
* ### Perc Test and Site Evaluation
  
  Soil percolation testing that measures drainage, confirms the seasonal high water table, and sets
  the drainfield size the Penobscot County health department will permit.
* ### Mound and Advanced Systems
  
  Engineered mound and pressure dosed systems for high water tables or shallow bedrock, building an
  elevated sand and gravel bed so the required four feet of vertical separation is met.

installation, drainfield construction, aerobic treatment units, septic tank replacement,
distribution box repair, and mound systems for high water tables under one local crew. We size every
concrete or polyethylene tank and leach field to the bedroom count and the soil, then set it to pass
inspection, whether your lot sits off Ohio Street in the Tree Streets or out toward Stillwater
Avenue near 04401.

Maine does not make onsite wastewater easy. The ground freezes deep, the frost line runs close to
four feet in Penobscot County, and spring meltwater pushes the seasonal high water table up fast. A
conventional gravity system that would drain fine in a warmer state can surface or back up here if
the drainfield is set too shallow or the vertical separation to groundwater is short. We plan for
the winters this region actually gets, not the average on a national chart.

The work starts with a perc test and soil profile so we know what the ground will accept before
anyone digs. From there we lay out the tank, the distribution box, and the trenches, then walk you
through a written estimate with the tank size, the gallon rating, and the permit path spelled out.
Most three bedroom homes take a 1,000 to 1,250 gallon tank; a four bedroom usually needs 1,500
gallons. There are no vague brackets, just the numbers your install requires.

Local knowledge is the difference on a Bangor job. Our crews know which streets sit on heavy clay,
where the county requires four feet of separation to the water table, and how to keep an excavation
open when the top of the soil is still frozen in April. That experience is why we can install in the
shoulder seasons that stall other contractors, and why a permit filed off Hammond Street clears

## Cold-Climate Septic Questions Answered

*How deep do you bury a septic system in Maine?*
  Deep enough to clear the frost line, which runs close to four feet in Penobscot County. The tank,
  lines, and drainfield are set so the system keeps flowing through winter, and risers with gasketed
  lids bring access back up near grade.
*What size septic tank do I need for my home?*
  Tank size follows bedroom count. A three bedroom home usually takes a 1,000 to 1,250 gallon tank,
  and a four bedroom needs 1,500 gallons. We confirm the size against the county requirements before
  we order the tank.
*Do I need a perc test before installing a septic system?*
  Yes. The soil percolation test and profile show how fast the ground drains and where the seasonal
  high water table sits. That data sets the drainfield size and tells us whether a conventional,
  mound, or aerobic system will pass here.
*Can you install a septic system in winter?*
  We install in the shoulder seasons and into the cold months when the schedule calls for it. Frozen
  surface soil adds labor to keep an excavation open, so we plan the timing and price it honestly
  rather than turning the job away.
*What do I do if my lot has a high water table?*
  High water tables are common on Maine parcels, and a conventional gravity drainfield will not
  always pass. An engineered mound or aerobic treatment unit lifts the treatment area so the

## Maine Septic Field Notes

Cold-climate installation insights for homeowners dealing with Maine frost and high water tables.

### [Planning a Septic Install Around Maine Frost and Water Tables][10]

July 1, 2026

[Septic system trench dug for a Bangor, ME install]

Installing a septic system in Bangor is not the same job it would be in a warmer state. Deep frost,
a short building window, and water tables that climb every spring all shape what will actually pass
and last here. If you are planning a new system or replacing a failed one, here is what to keep in
mind before the first shovel goes in.

### Respect the Frost Line

The frost line in Penobscot County runs close to four feet, and that number drives the whole design.
Tanks, supply lines, and the drainfield have to sit deep enough that the system keeps flowing when
the ground above it is frozen solid in January. Gasketed risers bring the access lids back up near
grade so you are not digging through frozen earth to pump the tank later.

### Test the Water Table, Not Just the Soil

A perc test tells you how fast the soil drains, but the seasonal high water table is what sinks a
lot of Maine drainfields. Ground that looks dry in August can be saturated in April when the
snowpack melts. The design has to keep four feet of vertical separation between the bottom of the
field and that high water mark, which is exactly why we check both during a [drainfield
installation][11] evaluation.

### Know When a Standard System Will Not Pass

On lots with heavy clay, shallow bedrock, or a persistently high water table, a conventional gravity
drainfield will not clear the county requirements. That is when an engineered mound or an aerobic
treatment unit earns its cost, lifting the treatment area so the separation is met. Finding this out
at the perc stage, before you have committed to a layout, saves real money.

### Build in the Right Season

Frozen surface soil makes an excavation slower and more expensive to keep open, so timing matters.
Many Bangor installs are best scheduled for the shoulder seasons, late spring through fall, when the
ground is workable and the schedule is predictable. Planning ahead means you are not stuck waiting
on a failed system in the middle of winter.

### Keep Up With Pumping

Once the system is in, the cheapest insurance is regular pumping. The EPA guidance is every three to
five years, which clears the sludge and scum before solids reach the field. A failed drainfield is
the costliest repair on the property, and routine service is what prevents it.

Every lot is different, and the only way to plan a system that fits yours is a real site evaluation.

  Engineered mound and pressure dosed systems for high water tables or shallow bedrock, building an
  elevated sand and gravel bed so the required four feet of vertical separation is met.

and packaging of food supplements and nutraceuticals.**

ensuring safe, compliant and scalable contract manufacturing for European brands.

development, private-label manufacturing and export-ready packaging. **[Find out our story][38]**

products include one of our many available formulas, which is then launched under your distinct
brand identity.

[Private Label involves creating a food supplement product from scratch based on your specific
requirements. You define the formula, dosage, flavor, packaging design, and other key elements. It’s
the right choice for those looking to build a unique and personalized brand.][43]
**[What Is White Label in Food Supplements? ][44]**
[White Label means ready-made products created by a manufacturer that you can brand as your own.
There’s no need to develop a formula or design—simply choose the product and apply your logo. It’s
an ideal solution for a quick and easy market launch.][45]

## We're on a mission to get the world onto the mushroom movement.

It’s simple: our founders discovered the cheat-code benefits of the world’s most powerful ancient
mushrooms, the effortless advantage of taking them to improve their day-to-day lives, and now we
want you to be a part of it.

[

The Bloomin Story

][33]

## A Peak into The Bloomin Community 👀

Your Bloomin Questions

How do you take it?

You can mix them, bake them, shake them into anything! The uses are endless but we love to have
Bloomin in our morning brews. Just add a pump or teaspoon of your chosen Bloomin blend to your drink
of choice and stir.

Are the mushrooms hallucinogenic?

No, there is no Psilocybin or any other hallucinogens present in any of our bloomin blends.

Can you take it every day?

Yes, all of our products are designed for daily use and ease to fit into your existing routine! We
like to pair up Focus and Boost together in the morning and then Rescue and Breathe together in the
afternoon for a supercharged day!

Can I mix the different blends?

You sure can. We like to pair Focus and Boost together in the morning, and then Rescue and Breathe
together in the afternoon or evening for a supercharged day! It's not unsafe to mix them all
together but we’ve found these combinations are the best for complimentary benefits.

Can you become addicted?

There is nothing present in our blends that can make you addicted to them, apart from the amazing
health benefits!

How long will delivery take?

We ship all orders with DPD 1-2 day delivery. All orders placed before 12pm are typically delivered
the next day. Receive free delivery on all orders over £35!

Can you just add it to hot water? I don’t like coffee or tea.

Yes, if you add to plain hot water it will have a slight earthy taste but it’s still pleasant.
Usually people add our powders to existing products like coffee, smoothies, brownies or overnight
oats to boost their day - the sky's the limit!

I’m pretty new to mushrooms - which blend would you recommend for a beginner?

All our blends are safe and effective for new users. They’re designed for everyone! If you’re having
trouble deciding, we’ve curated a quiz that will match you with the perfect blend, everyone is
different so we wanted to build a personalised approach so you can get the best results from your
blend!


[You can click here to take the quiz.][34]

mushrooms, the effortless advantage of taking them to improve their day-to-day lives, and now we
want you to be a part of it.

Your Bloomin Questions

How do you take it?

You can mix them, bake them, shake them into anything! The uses are endless but we love to have
Bloomin in our morning brews. Just add a pump or teaspoon of your chosen Bloomin blend to your drink
of choice and stir.

Are the mushrooms hallucinogenic?

No, there is no Psilocybin or any other hallucinogens present in any of our bloomin blends.

Can you take it every day?

like to pair up Focus and Boost together in the morning and then Rescue and Breathe together in the

## Bulk Wholesale Mushrooms - Frequently Asked Questions [FAQ]

### Do Any Of Your Tinctures Contain Alcohol?

Absolutely! Our mushrooms are steeped in high-grade organic alcohol, and extraction lasts for at
least 100 days, ensuring the highest quality product possible.

### Can Functional Mushroom Products Have Side Effects?

Rest assured that our mushroom products are widely accepted as safe. However, to be on the safe
side, it is advisable to consult your health practitioner before taking any of our products if you
have any
reservations or questions.

### Are Bulk Wholesale Mushrooms Products Organic?

Absolutely! All our precious mushroom products are proudly USDA Organic Certified by
https://nfccertification.com/. Our mushroom goods provide peace of mind knowing they only contain
organic ingredients with no unnecessary additives or fillers.

### Do Bulk Mushroom Products Expire?

Like other organic supplements, our bulk mushroom products do eventually expire. Fortunately, Our
mushroom products can be stored for up to two years! If you have any inquiries regarding your
particular product, feel free to contact us at hello@bulkwholesalemushrooms.com, and we'll gladly
answer them!

### How To Store Bulk Mushroom Products

When it comes to storing mushroom supplements, a little extra care is necessary. For long-term
storage, here are a few tips on how to keep your supplements fresh:
* Utilize airtight containers – look for wide-mouthed, airtight containers with an easy seal. This
  will help keep moisture out and stop oxidation from occurring.
* Store in a cool and dry place – temperatures between 40-70°F (4–21°C) and humidity levels around
  50% are ideal for preserving the integrity of the product.
* Keep away from direct sunlight – UV light can affect the supplement's effectiveness, so it’s best
  to store them away from windowsills or any other natural light source.
* Check expiration dates regularly – be mindful of expiration dates when purchasing in bulk, as some
  products may spoil sooner than others. By following these tips, you can ensure that your bulk
  mushroom supplements stay fresh and effective over time!

### What Are Triple-Extracted Tinctures?

We proudly utilize our unique three-step extraction process that is unparalleled worldwide. It
begins with fermentation to optimize the bioavailability of polysaccharides, triterpenoids, and
alkaloid concentrations. Subsequently, we use hot water extraction for polysaccharides followed by
90 days of alcohol extraction for triterpenoids - all adding up to an extensive 100-day period per
extract!

### How Are Your Bulk Mushrooms Grown?

Our mushrooms are cultivated meticulously in the magnificent Pacific Northwest, using only certified
organic methods.

### Do Our Mushrooms Undergo Heavy Metal Testing, Myotoxins, And Other Lab Tests?

Yes, to view the lab testing results or Certificate of Analysis (COA) for each product, you can
check out its corresponding wholesale product page.

least 100 days, ensuring the highest quality product possible.

### Can Functional Mushroom Products Have Side Effects?

Rest assured that our mushroom products are widely accepted as safe. However, to be on the safe
side, it is advisable to consult your health practitioner before taking any of our products if you
have any
reservations or questions.

### Are Bulk Wholesale Mushrooms Products Organic?

Absolutely! All our precious mushroom products are proudly USDA Organic Certified by
https://nfccertification.com/. Our mushroom goods provide peace of mind knowing they only contain
organic ingredients with no unnecessary additives or fillers.

### Do Bulk Mushroom Products Expire?

Like other organic supplements, our bulk mushroom products do eventually expire. Fortunately, Our
mushroom products can be stored for up to two years! If you have any inquiries regarding your
particular product, feel free to contact us at hello@bulkwholesalemushrooms.com, and we'll gladly
answer them!

### How To Store Bulk Mushroom Products

When it comes to storing mushroom supplements, a little extra care is necessary. For long-term
storage, here are a few tips on how to keep your supplements fresh:
* Utilize airtight containers – look for wide-mouthed, airtight containers with an easy seal. This
  will help keep moisture out and stop oxidation from occurring.
* Store in a cool and dry place – temperatures between 40-70°F (4–21°C) and humidity levels around
  50% are ideal for preserving the integrity of the product.
* Keep away from direct sunlight – UV light can affect the supplement's effectiveness, so it’s best
  to store them away from windowsills or any other natural light source.
* Check expiration dates regularly – be mindful of expiration dates when purchasing in bulk, as some
  products may spoil sooner than others. By following these tips, you can ensure that your bulk
  mushroom supplements stay fresh and effective over time!

### What Are Triple-Extracted Tinctures?

We proudly utilize our unique three-step extraction process that is unparalleled worldwide. It
begins with fermentation to optimize the bioavailability of polysaccharides, triterpenoids, and
alkaloid concentrations. Subsequently, we use hot water extraction for polysaccharides followed by
90 days of alcohol extraction for triterpenoids - all adding up to an extensive 100-day period per
extract!

### How Are Your Bulk Mushrooms Grown?

Our mushrooms are cultivated meticulously in the magnificent Pacific Northwest, using only certified
organic methods.

### Do Our Mushrooms Undergo Heavy Metal Testing, Myotoxins, And Other Lab Tests?

Yes, to view the lab testing results or Certificate of Analysis (COA) for each product, you can
check out its corresponding wholesale product page.

## How CBD could supercharge your wellness

CBD is one of the world’s most popular wellness compounds. Its beneficial effects on the human body
are a direct result of its interaction with your body’s endocannabinoid system (also called the
ECS). This special system is responsible for regulating emotional, physical, and oxidative balance.
CBD may help your ECS stay firing on all cylinders by binding to its CB2 receptors. In other words,
CBD activates parts of your body responsible for balancing itself. CBD’s activation of the
endocannabinoid system is what allows it to have such far-reaching health benefits!

## How CBD could supercharge your wellness

CBD is one of the world’s most popular wellness compounds. Its beneficial effects on the human body
are a direct result of its interaction with your body’s endocannabinoid system (also called the
ECS). This special system is responsible for regulating emotional, physical, and oxidative balance.
CBD may help your ECS stay firing on all cylinders by binding to its CB2 receptors. In other words,
CBD activates parts of your body responsible for balancing itself. CBD’s activation of the
endocannabinoid system is what allows it to have such far-reaching health benefits!

# Vegan recipes for a healthy life and healthy planet

Clean Green Simple is a plant-based resource for people interested in eating mindfully, living
sustainably, and enjoying life’s simple pleasures. We offer plant-based recipes and nutrition tips,
as well as reviews and buying guides for eco-friendly kitchen, home, and health products.

Wherever you are on your plant-based journey—from plant-curious to 100% vegan— my crew and I are
here to provide you a judgment-free zone that will help empower you to adopt a plant-centric
lifestyle.

We’re excited for the future of 2026! We will soon be offering a convenient mobile app so you can
connect seamlessly to our resources where ever you may be. A membership based meal planning program,
new authors from around the world bringing international flavor to the vegan lifestyle and even a
small commerce section offering uniquely branded T shirt designs showing your vegan pride.

## **Organic Vegan Chocolate**

Hey there, fellow chocolate lover! Let us introduce you to our scrumptious and health-conscious

Hey there, fellow chocolate lover! Let us introduce you to our scrumptious and health-conscious
Coracao Confections' organic vegan chocolate. We promise you, this is not just any old vegan
chocolate. It's a downright decadent experience, bursting with incredible flavors, packed with
nourishing ingredients, and made with love for our planet.

We're Coracao & CACOCO, a bunch of chocolate enthusiasts who are obsessed with quality and
sustainability. We've poured our hearts into crafting vegan chocolate that not only tastes amazing
but also suits all dietary preferences. Our goodies are vegan, gluten-free, dairy-free, soy-free,
peanut-free, and refined sugar-free. That's right, guilt-free pleasure that everyone can indulge in,
no matter their dietary restrictions!

We're proud to be an employee-owned, Certified Climate Neutral company. For us, it's all about
loving our planet just as much as we love chocolate. We source organic, fair-trade cacao, because we
believe in doing the right thing right from the roots. Our luscious dark chocolate shell is a
whopping 81% cacao, making every bite an explosion of intense, indulgent flavor.

Now, let's talk about the stars of our chocolate show:
* **Berkeley Bar:** A delightful combo of maca and lucuma nougat, silky cashew butter caramel, and
  crunchy almonds, all wrapped up in our dark chocolate shell.
* **Raw Fudge Truffle:** A chocolate lover's dream, with its velvety chocolate ganache speckled with
  crunchy cacao nibs.
* **Almond Butter Cup:** Creamy stone-ground almond butter heart encased in chocolate.
* **Raspberry Fudge Truffle:** Sweet raspberry-infused ganache with a dried raspberry topper for an
  irresistible fruity twist.
* **Rose Truffle:** A unique blend of sweet ganache and aromatic organic Bulgarian rose oil.
* **Lemon Caramel Cup:** Tangy lemon-infused cashew butter caramel.

We've carefully picked every single ingredient to create our heavenly chocolates. Everything from
cacao and coconut sugar to cashew butter, almonds, and exciting extras like lucuma, maca, and yacon
is chosen with both health and taste in mind. We love adding the extra crunch of cacao nibs, the
tart sweetness of raspberry, and the fragrant hint of rose petals and rose oil to keep our flavors
fresh and exciting.

When it comes to our vegan chocolate, it's all about conscious indulgence. Every nibble is a pledge
to sustainable practices, responsible sourcing, and thoughtful, health-conscious ingredients. Every
time you bite into our organic vegan chocolate, you're not just enjoying a delicious treat—you're
making a difference.

So, the next time you're hankering for some vegan chocolate, choose our organic vegan chocolate.
Unwrap, take a bite, and let the flavors transport you to a world of blissful indulgence where good
taste meets sustainability.

sustainability. We've poured our hearts into crafting vegan chocolate that not only tastes amazing
but also suits all dietary preferences. Our goodies are vegan, gluten-free, dairy-free, soy-free,
peanut-free, and refined sugar-free. That's right, guilt-free pleasure that everyone can indulge in,
no matter their dietary restrictions!

We're proud to be an employee-owned, Certified Climate Neutral company. For us, it's all about
loving our planet just as much as we love chocolate. We source organic, fair-trade cacao, because we
believe in doing the right thing right from the roots. Our luscious dark chocolate shell is a
whopping 81% cacao, making every bite an explosion of intense, indulgent flavor.

Now, let's talk about the stars of our chocolate show:
* **Berkeley Bar:** A delightful combo of maca and lucuma nougat, silky cashew butter caramel, and
  crunchy almonds, all wrapped up in our dark chocolate shell.
* **Raw Fudge Truffle:** A chocolate lover's dream, with its velvety chocolate ganache speckled with
  crunchy cacao nibs.
* **Almond Butter Cup:** Creamy stone-ground almond butter heart encased in chocolate.
* **Raspberry Fudge Truffle:** Sweet raspberry-infused ganache with a dried raspberry topper for an
  irresistible fruity twist.
* **Rose Truffle:** A unique blend of sweet ganache and aromatic organic Bulgarian rose oil.
* **Lemon Caramel Cup:** Tangy lemon-infused cashew butter caramel.

We've carefully picked every single ingredient to create our heavenly chocolates. Everything from
cacao and coconut sugar to cashew butter, almonds, and exciting extras like lucuma, maca, and yacon
is chosen with both health and taste in mind. We love adding the extra crunch of cacao nibs, the
tart sweetness of raspberry, and the fragrant hint of rose petals and rose oil to keep our flavors
fresh and exciting.

When it comes to our vegan chocolate, it's all about conscious indulgence. Every nibble is a pledge
to sustainable practices, responsible sourcing, and thoughtful, health-conscious ingredients. Every
time you bite into our organic vegan chocolate, you're not just enjoying a delicious treat—you're
making a difference.

So, the next time you're hankering for some vegan chocolate, choose our organic vegan chocolate.
Unwrap, take a bite, and let the flavors transport you to a world of blissful indulgence where good
taste meets sustainability.

nutritional value. Functional mushrooms have been used for centuries in Chinese Medicine and

Nope, sorry! Functional mushrooms to contain a variety of natural bio-chemicals and compound

Functional Mushrooms can have various health benefits. Unlike Magic Mushrooms, Functional Mushrooms

**Our Founders **Warren and Mike (Dr. Micheal Walker, PhD Environmental Sciences) have both left

Is there a downside to taking mushroom supplements?
Virtually no negative side effects, when taken in the right dosage. The health benefits, on the
other hand are endless: they support cognitive function, reduce brain fog, reduce stress, improve
mental performance, improve your energy levels, improve sleep, boost your immune system, and boost
your overall health in general
What are adaptogen drinks?
Adaptogen drinks are beverages infused with natural ingredients like functional mushrooms and herbs
that help the body adapt to stress, improve energy, and support mental clarity.


What is the best adaptogen drink?
The best adaptogen drink depends on personal preference and goals, but those containing a mix of
nootropic mushrooms like Lion’s Mane, Reishi, and Cordyceps are often recommended for balanced
benefits, like our very own Eons Smart Mushroom Coffee.
What is the most effective adaptogen?
Effectiveness varies, but Cordyceps is known for boosting physical performance and giving extra
energy, Reishi for promoting relaxation and reducing stress, and Lion’s Mane for enhancing cognitive
function.

# Empowering Health with Functional Mushrooms

Join a coalition of North American growers and experts dedicated to advancing the science,
education, and appreciation of functional mushrooms.

[ Become a Member ][16]
[ Learn More ][17]

## FMC

###### - Educating, Promoting, and Learning

## The Functional Mushroom Council (FMC) is a coalition

of dedicated North American growers committed to promoting the numerous benefits of functional
mushrooms. Through rigorous research, education, and strategic promotion, we aim to increase
consumer awareness and support the regular consumption of high-quality, US-grown functional
mushrooms.

###### - Empowering

## At FMC, we empower individuals and companies alike to integrate functional mushrooms into their
## daily health routines.

We are determined to build a stronger future together by promoting a culture of solidarity and
cooperation.

As a trusted resource for facts, data, and research, we unite industry leaders to create a
healthier, more informed community of consumers.

###### - Guiding Principles

## Advancing Functional Mushroom Awareness and Standards

Fostering research, education, and collaboration to promote the health benefits and responsible
consumption of functional mushrooms.

#### Research

We collaborate with our members to conduct groundbreaking studies that support the health benefits
of functional mushrooms.

#### Education

Through comprehensive education, we aim to raise awareness and provide consumers with the
information they need to make informed decisions about their health.

#### Promotion

Our collective efforts help highlight the value of functional mushrooms, driving increased
consumption and well-being.

## Inviting companies, growers, and industry professionals to become part of a growing movement

Join today and be part of a growing community of innovators bringing functional mushrooms to the
forefront of health and wellness.

## FMC

###### - Educating, Promoting, and Learning

## The Functional Mushroom Council (FMC) is a coalition

of dedicated North American growers committed to promoting the numerous benefits of functional
mushrooms. Through rigorous research, education, and strategic promotion, we aim to increase
consumer awareness and support the regular consumption of high-quality, US-grown functional
mushrooms.

20+
strains cultivated in the US
11.2%
CAGR growth projection
$31.7b
global market value

of applications

###### - Empowering

## At FMC, we empower individuals and companies alike to integrate functional mushrooms into their
## daily health routines.

We are determined to build a stronger future together by promoting a culture of solidarity and
cooperation.

As a trusted resource for facts, data, and research, we unite industry leaders to create a
healthier, more informed community of consumers.

###### - Guiding Principles

## Advancing Functional Mushroom Awareness and Standards

Fostering research, education, and collaboration to promote the health benefits and responsible
consumption of functional mushrooms.

#### Research

We collaborate with our members to conduct groundbreaking studies that support the health benefits
of functional mushrooms.

#### Education

Through comprehensive education, we aim to raise awareness and provide consumers with the
information they need to make informed decisions about their health.

#### Promotion

Our collective efforts help highlight the value of functional mushrooms, driving increased
consumption and well-being.

## Inviting companies, growers, and industry professionals to become part of a growing movement

Join today and be part of a growing community of innovators bringing functional mushrooms to the
forefront of health and wellness.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is Sauce?

Sauce is a first-party restaurant ordering and delivery platform that helps restaurants own their
customer relationships, grow direct online sales, and increase profitability.

Instead of relying entirely on third-party marketplaces, Sauce gives restaurants the tools to run
branded online ordering, delivery, customer marketing, loyalty, and guest engagement under their own
brand.

Plus: You’ll now be able to utilize several leading delivery couriers throughout the country. So
you’ll no longer be at the mercy of a single provider. You’re protecting your margins while saying
goodbye to paying 30% commission per delivery order!

How does Sauce help owners get more online orders and repeat customers?

Sauce helps restaurants drive more direct orders through a branded online ordering experience that
feels just as seamless and reliable as the major third-party apps — while keeping the restaurant’s
brand front and center.

Customers get a fast, modern delivery and ordering experience they already expect, which encourages
them to reorder again and again directly from the restaurant instead of through marketplaces.

Restaurants can:
* Offer fast, mobile-friendly direct ordering
* Provide a delivery experience on par with third-party platforms
* Re-engage customers with automated email and SMS marketing
* Build loyalty and repeat visits with rewards and retention tools
* Capture customer data and ordering history
* Reduce dependence on expensive third-party apps that own the guest relationship

The result is more repeat customers, higher order frequency, and stronger long-term customer value

How does Sauce help owners make more profit?

Sauce helps improve restaurant margins by shifting orders from high-commission third-party platforms
to direct ordering channels. Restaurants keep more revenue from every order while also increasing
customer lifetime value.

Owners typically benefit from:
* Lower commission costs on online orders
* Higher-margin direct orders
* Increased repeat business from existing customers
* Better operational efficiency through POS integrations and centralized order management
* More control over delivery economics and customer experience

Instead of paying to reacquire the same customer through marketplaces, Sauce helps restaurants build
their own profitable customer base.

Is Sauce Direct Delivery truly commission-free, or is there a catch?

Yes, Sauce truly is commission-free — and no, there’s no catch. We charge a small flat fixed fee
that doesn’t increase with the order size. This means that Sauce users will now pay a low flat fixed
fee per delivery order, regardless of order size and regardless of distance up to five miles (and up
to 20 miles in selected cities).

Plus: You’ll now be able to utilize several leading delivery couriers throughout the country. So
you’ll no longer be at the mercy of a single provider. You’re protecting your margins while saying
goodbye to paying 30% commission per delivery order!

Which problems does Sauce solve best for restaurant owners?

Sauce is especially effective for restaurants that want to:
– Reduce reliance on third-party delivery apps
– Increase direct online ordering
– Improve customer retention and loyalty
– Own their customer data
– Increase profitability from delivery and takeout
– Modernize their online ordering experience
– Simplify delivery operations
– Launch digital marketing campaigns that actually drive repeat orders

Sauce works best when restaurants want to grow digitally without giving away their margins or
customer relationships.

Is Sauce a POS company?

No. Sauce is not a POS company.

Sauce integrates with leading POS systems to extend and enhance a restaurant’s digital ordering,
delivery, and customer engagement capabilities. The POS remains the restaurant’s system of record,
while Sauce powers the guest-facing digital experience and direct ordering growth

Is Sauce a delivery company?

Sauce is not a traditional delivery marketplace.

By connecting to multiple delivery companies, Sauce helps restaurants manage and optimize delivery
for their own customers. Depending on the restaurant’s setup, Sauce can support delivery
orchestration, dispatching, and delivery provider integrations while keeping the restaurant’s brand
front and center.

The focus is on helping restaurants own the customer relationship — not competing with them for it.

Who are the drivers that Sauce partners with?

We partner with the national delivery companies, as well as local ones.

This way, restaurants are not at the mercy of just one provider, and can utilize a dispatch system
with Sauce that always selects the most readily available driver, all commission-free!

Which POS systems does Sauce integrate with?

Sauce integrates with Toast and Square

Which restaurants get the most value with Sauce?

Sauce delivers the most value for restaurants that:
* Already have strong demand on delivery apps and want to convert customers to direct ordering
* Depend heavily on takeout and delivery revenue
* Want to improve margins
* Care about branding and customer ownership
* Want better marketing and retention tools
* Are looking to scale digital sales efficiently

Independent restaurants, regional chains, fast casual brands, pizza concepts, and high-volume
takeout businesses often see especially strong results.

Getting started with Sauce: how fast is it? When do I see results?

Most restaurants can get up and running with Sauce quickly, often within days depending on the POS
setup and onboarding requirements.

Restaurants typically begin seeing:
* Increased direct online orders shortly after launch
* Higher repeat ordering within the first few weeks
* Improved profitability as more customers shift away from third-party ordering channels over time

The fastest results usually come from restaurants that actively promote their direct ordering
channels to existing customers.

I do not own my website. Does Sauce provide an alternative?

Yes.

Restaurants do not need to have an existing website to start using Sauce. Sauce can provide a
branded website and direct ordering solutions even if a restaurant does not currently own or manage
a website.

This allows restaurants to launch direct ordering quickly while still offering customers a
professional branded experience.

Sauce integrates with leading POS systems to extend and enhance a restaurant’s digital ordering,
delivery, and customer engagement capabilities. The POS remains the restaurant’s system of record,
while Sauce powers the guest-facing digital experience and direct ordering growth

Is Sauce a delivery company?

Sauce is not a traditional delivery marketplace.

By connecting to multiple delivery companies, Sauce helps restaurants manage and optimize delivery
for their own customers. Depending on the restaurant’s setup, Sauce can support delivery
orchestration, dispatching, and delivery provider integrations while keeping the restaurant’s brand
front and center.

The focus is on helping restaurants own the customer relationship — not competing with them for it.

Who are the drivers that Sauce partners with?

We partner with the national delivery companies, as well as local ones.

This way, restaurants are not at the mercy of just one provider, and can utilize a dispatch system
with Sauce that always selects the most readily available driver, all commission-free!

Which POS systems does Sauce integrate with?

Sauce integrates with Toast and Square

Which restaurants get the most value with Sauce?

Sauce delivers the most value for restaurants that:
* Already have strong demand on delivery apps and want to convert customers to direct ordering
* Depend heavily on takeout and delivery revenue
* Want to improve margins
* Care about branding and customer ownership
* Want better marketing and retention tools
* Are looking to scale digital sales efficiently

Independent restaurants, regional chains, fast casual brands, pizza concepts, and high-volume
takeout businesses often see especially strong results.

Getting started with Sauce: how fast is it? When do I see results?

Most restaurants can get up and running with Sauce quickly, often within days depending on the POS
setup and onboarding requirements.

Restaurants typically begin seeing:
* Increased direct online orders shortly after launch
* Higher repeat ordering within the first few weeks
* Improved profitability as more customers shift away from third-party ordering channels over time

The fastest results usually come from restaurants that actively promote their direct ordering
channels to existing customers.

I do not own my website. Does Sauce provide an alternative?

Yes.

Restaurants do not need to have an existing website to start using Sauce. Sauce can provide a
branded website and direct ordering solutions even if a restaurant does not currently own or manage
a website.

This allows restaurants to launch direct ordering quickly while still offering customers a
professional branded experience.

## Getting started

### Where are KÄÄPÄ organic mushroom supplements made of?

KÄÄPÄ Mushrooms are cultivated in Finland, where the clean air, water and strict organic growing
standards ensure premium quality. Unlike many mushroom products, KÄÄPÄ mushrooms undergo rigorous
quality control and full traceability to ensure purity and potency.

### How do KÄÄPÄ products differ from other mushroom supplements?

KÄÄPÄ Mushrooms stands out due to its commitment to purity, potency, and transparency. Unlike many
mushroom products, KÄÄPÄ mushrooms are cultivated in Finland, where the pristine air, water, and
soil provide the perfect conditions for high-quality mushrooms. Each batch undergoes third-party
testing, ensuring purity, safety, and a verified concentration of active compounds.

### What is NordRelease® extraction?


NordRelease® is our uniquely refined extraction method a proprietary process that sets our mushroom
extracts apart in terms of purity, stability, and consistency. We have evolved ultrasonic-assisted
extraction (UAE) technology that uses high-frequency sound waves to break open the tough chitin cell
walls of mushrooms, releasing a higher stability and more thorough amount of active compounds. Our
refined process ensures superior bioavailability, preserving delicate bioactive molecules while
efficiently extracting both water-soluble and fat-soluble compounds, delivering a full-spectrum,
highly active mushroom extract.


### KÄÄPÄ is an honest mushroom supplement company, what does this mean?

In a consumer world which wants to see more honesty and transparency, we are one of the only
mushroom brands in the world which provides customers with a product QR code (on the side of
packaging) where you can enter the lot number, to access batch-specific data. This includes data on
bioactive compounds, and access to heavy metal and microbial 3rd party test results. We are setting
new standards for trustworthiness in the mushroom industry.

### Is there alcohol in your liquid extracts?

Yes. Ethanol is added to the liquid extracts for preservation purposes. All the finished liquid
extract products contain 20% alcohol. With alcohol content more than 20%, the Compounds of Interest
and the product quality stay intact for up to 3 years.

### How pure are KÄÄPÄ mushroom products?

Whether grown outdoors in the pure Finnish air on birch trees or on PEFC/FCA certified Finnish birch
as our growing substrate, there is no purer method for growing mushrooms. We also give customer the
ability to scan the QR code and access the heavy metal and microbial 3rd party test results.

### Why does KÄÄPÄ Mushrooms use only fruiting bodies instead of mycelium?

KÄÄPÄ Mushrooms uses 100% fruiting bodies because they contain the highest concentration of active
compounds like beta-glucans, triterpenes, hericenones, erinacines, and cordycepin, which provide the
key health benefits of medicinal mushrooms. Some brands use mycelium grown on grain, which often
contains high levels of starch and fillers with significantly lower levels of beneficial compounds.

### Which form is stronger between KÄÄPÄ liquid extracts, powders and elixirs?

The choice comes down to personal preference.


**Liquid extracts**
offer the fastest absorption as they are taken sublingually (under the tongue) or in drinks,
allowing the body to absorb active compounds more quickly.

**Powders
**can be easily mixed into drinks smoothies, coffee, or food.

**Elixirs**
offer an alcohol free experience where you can add it to drinks, smoothies, cereals and it can be
taken sublingually for faster absorption.There’s no exact science on which is “better” as individual
digestion and metabolism vary, but all forms deliver the key active compounds needed for
results—it’s simply a matter of what fits best into your routine.

### How long will delivery take to receive my product?

Finland: Delivery in **2–5 business days**. Free shipping on orders over **€70**.

Europe: Delivery in **4–8 business days**. Free shipping on orders over **€100**.

America & Canada: Delivery in **6–10 business days**. Free shipping on orders over **€120**.


### What is the refund policy?

If you are not satisfied with your purchase, you may request a refund within **14 days** of
receiving your order. To be eligible for a refund, the item must be **unused, unopened**, and in its
**original packaging**. Please contact our customer service before returning any items. Once we
receive and inspect the returned product, we will notify you and process the refund to your original
payment method.

**Note:** Shipping costs are non-refundable. Customers are responsible for return shipping unless
the item was damaged or incorrect.

## Getting started

### Where are KÄÄPÄ organic mushroom supplements made of?

KÄÄPÄ Mushrooms are cultivated in Finland, where the clean air, water and strict organic growing
standards ensure premium quality. Unlike many mushroom products, KÄÄPÄ mushrooms undergo rigorous
quality control and full traceability to ensure purity and potency.

### How do KÄÄPÄ products differ from other mushroom supplements?

KÄÄPÄ Mushrooms stands out due to its commitment to purity, potency, and transparency. Unlike many
mushroom products, KÄÄPÄ mushrooms are cultivated in Finland, where the pristine air, water, and
soil provide the perfect conditions for high-quality mushrooms. Each batch undergoes third-party
testing, ensuring purity, safety, and a verified concentration of active compounds.

### What is NordRelease® extraction?


NordRelease® is our uniquely refined extraction method a proprietary process that sets our mushroom
extracts apart in terms of purity, stability, and consistency. We have evolved ultrasonic-assisted
extraction (UAE) technology that uses high-frequency sound waves to break open the tough chitin cell
walls of mushrooms, releasing a higher stability and more thorough amount of active compounds. Our
refined process ensures superior bioavailability, preserving delicate bioactive molecules while
efficiently extracting both water-soluble and fat-soluble compounds, delivering a full-spectrum,
highly active mushroom extract.


### KÄÄPÄ is an honest mushroom supplement company, what does this mean?

In a consumer world which wants to see more honesty and transparency, we are one of the only
mushroom brands in the world which provides customers with a product QR code (on the side of
packaging) where you can enter the lot number, to access batch-specific data. This includes data on
bioactive compounds, and access to heavy metal and microbial 3rd party test results. We are setting
new standards for trustworthiness in the mushroom industry.

### Is there alcohol in your liquid extracts?

Yes. Ethanol is added to the liquid extracts for preservation purposes. All the finished liquid
extract products contain 20% alcohol. With alcohol content more than 20%, the Compounds of Interest
and the product quality stay intact for up to 3 years.

### How pure are KÄÄPÄ mushroom products?

Whether grown outdoors in the pure Finnish air on birch trees or on PEFC/FCA certified Finnish birch
as our growing substrate, there is no purer method for growing mushrooms. We also give customer the
ability to scan the QR code and access the heavy metal and microbial 3rd party test results.

### Why does KÄÄPÄ Mushrooms use only fruiting bodies instead of mycelium?

KÄÄPÄ Mushrooms uses 100% fruiting bodies because they contain the highest concentration of active
compounds like beta-glucans, triterpenes, hericenones, erinacines, and cordycepin, which provide the
key health benefits of medicinal mushrooms. Some brands use mycelium grown on grain, which often
contains high levels of starch and fillers with significantly lower levels of beneficial compounds.

### Which form is stronger between KÄÄPÄ liquid extracts, powders and elixirs?

The choice comes down to personal preference.


**Liquid extracts**
offer the fastest absorption as they are taken sublingually (under the tongue) or in drinks,
allowing the body to absorb active compounds more quickly.

**Powders
**can be easily mixed into drinks smoothies, coffee, or food.

**Elixirs**
offer an alcohol free experience where you can add it to drinks, smoothies, cereals and it can be
taken sublingually for faster absorption.There’s no exact science on which is “better” as individual
digestion and metabolism vary, but all forms deliver the key active compounds needed for
results—it’s simply a matter of what fits best into your routine.

### How long will delivery take to receive my product?

Finland: Delivery in **2–5 business days**. Free shipping on orders over **€70**.

Europe: Delivery in **4–8 business days**. Free shipping on orders over **€100**.

America & Canada: Delivery in **6–10 business days**. Free shipping on orders over **€120**.


### What is the refund policy?

If you are not satisfied with your purchase, you may request a refund within **14 days** of
receiving your order. To be eligible for a refund, the item must be **unused, unopened**, and in its
**original packaging**. Please contact our customer service before returning any items. Once we
receive and inspect the returned product, we will notify you and process the refund to your original
payment method.

**Note:** Shipping costs are non-refundable. Customers are responsible for return shipping unless

## SCIENCE-BACKED BENEFITS

COGNITIVE HEALTH

Lion’s Mane (Hericium erinaceus) and Reishi (Ganoderma lucidum s.l.) have a rich history of
traditional use spanning millennia, where they are revered for their health benefits properties.
Modern clinical research is increasingly validating these historical applications. Lion’s Mane has
demonstrated potential in stimulating Nerve Growth Factor (NGF) production, crucial for neuronal
health and cognitive function, while Reishi’s exhibit adaptogenic and immunomodulatory effects. 

 

When consumed regularly in as whole mushrooms encompassing the complete range of bioactive
compounds, these organisms have shown promise in supporting various aspects of cognition, including
memory, focus, mood and overall brain health. M2 leverages this scientific understanding, offering
both individual species and custom, proprietary blends designed to optimize cognitive health .

DIGESTIVE HEALTH

Whole mushrooms are a rich source of both soluble and insoluble fiber and both beta glucans and
chitin, 2 major carbohydrates found in all mushrooms are known as prebiotics. Clinical evidence of
the benefits of functional mushrooms on digestive health is mounting and led M2 to invest in this
area of research. M2’s collaboration with Prodigest has provided scientific evidence supporting the
prebiotic potential of full-spectrum whole mushroom products. Utilizing microbiome samples from
healthy adults in an artificial gut model, the studies demonstrated that M2’s proprietary mushrooms
significantly fostered the growth of beneficial gut bacteria, leading to a cascade of positive
effects. Notably, the mushrooms effectively lowered colonic pH, indicative of lactate production by
*Bifidobacteria*, and avoided adverse effects like bloating. Furthermore, they significantly
elevated short-chain fatty acid (SCFA) production, particularly butyrate, crucial for cognitive
function, gut health, and immunity, suggesting a diverse and active microbiota through
cross-feeding. This was accompanied by a measurable increase in overall microbiota biomass and a
positive shift in microbial species diversity. Beyond these core prebiotic effects, the study also
revealed metabolic outcomes linked to the mushrooms, indicating modulation of various neuroactive
metabolites, suggesting a potential connection between gut health and neurological function.

IMMUNE SUPPORT

M2’s whole  mushroom products influence immune function through the activation of both innate and
adaptive immune responses. Traditional use of species like Reishi, Turkey Tail, and the Royal Sun
mushroom has demonstrated their immunomodulatory capabilities. These mushrooms contain bioactive
compounds that stimulate the body’s initial immune defenses (innate immunity), such as inflammation
and cellular defenses. Simultaneously, they also enhance the development of targeted immune
responses (adaptive immunity), including antibody production. This combined effect strengthens
overall immune system function, contributing to improved health.

ATHLETIC PERFORMANCE

M2’s whole mushroom Cordyceps can positively impact athletic performance by enhancing the body’s

## How it works?

Why Medikonda? Gain instant access to 2,000+ ingredients, downloadable QC documents, and
ready-to-use starter formulations, US ready inventory—all in one place.
* ### Instant access to the industry’s most comprehensive catalog
  
  *Browse, search, and filter the USA’s largest food ingredient catalog with ease.*
* ### Order samples, access QC docs, and secure quotes instantly
  
  *The Medikonda Concierge manages all your requests and ensures they’re processed faster than
  ever.*
* ### Real-time inventory, right here in the USA
  
  *Tiered pricing, real-time U.S. inventory, expert food technologist support, and everything you
  need to accelerate product development.*

1 / of 3

## What makes us stand out of the crowd?
* ### Consistency
  
  All of our products are created using the same extraction process in the same facility, which
  creates consistency. This ensures that you will receive a product that’s always reliable and
  effective.
* ### Premium Grade
  
  Our products are considered premium grade because they are manufactured using the highest
  standards. We only  offer products of the highest purity with no binders, fillers, excipients,
  dyes or unknown substances.
* ### Every Batch is Tested
  
  Our standards are rigorous and thorough. We test every single batch of our herbs and oils  through
  a third-party lab to ensure that the products you receive are the highest quality available,
  without pesticides or heavy metals.
* ### Customer Support
  
  We stand behind our products and reputation with something more than professional pride — this
  company is truly a labor of love, and it shows in every moment of your shopping experience. We
  always provide world-class customer support.
* ### Low MOQ
  
  We know that every big company had a small beginning. Hence, We offer even smaller quantities and
  Low Minimum Order Quantity requirement.
* ### Co-Packing & Contract Manufacturing
  
  Contract manufacturing, Co-packing and private labeling is available. Please ask us about this
  option.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

## Common Questions from B2B Buyers

What is the minimum order quantity?

Our standard MOQ is **1 kg per SKU**. We offer pack sizes of 1 kg, 5 kg, and 25 kg. For pallet
orders (100+ kg), contact us for volume pricing.

Are your extracts from fruiting bodies or mycelium?

**Fruiting bodies only.** All extracts are 4:1 hot water extracted from the actual mushroom fruiting
body — not mycelium-on-grain. This is a firm quality standard verified by COA.

Can I get a Certificate of Analysis (COA)?

Yes. COAs are available for all SKUs on request and provided with every order. Each COA covers
beta-glucan content, polysaccharides, heavy metals, pesticide residues, microbial counts, moisture,
and ash.

What are your lead times?

Standard 1–25 kg orders ship from our Newark, NJ warehouse within **2–3 weeks** of order
confirmation. Pallet orders (100+ kg): 4–6 weeks. Custom blend orders: contact us for timeline.

Do you ship internationally?

Yes. We ship to the EU, UK, Canada, Australia, Southeast Asia, and other major markets. Full export
documentation (COA, MSDS, import declaration support) is provided with all international orders.

## Common Questions from B2B Buyers

What is the minimum order quantity?

Our standard MOQ is **1 kg per SKU**. We offer pack sizes of 1 kg, 5 kg, and 25 kg. For pallet
orders (100+ kg), contact us for volume pricing.

Are your extracts from fruiting bodies or mycelium?

**Fruiting bodies only.** All extracts are 4:1 hot water extracted from the actual mushroom fruiting
body — not mycelium-on-grain. This is a firm quality standard verified by COA.

Can I get a Certificate of Analysis (COA)?

Yes. COAs are available for all SKUs on request and provided with every order. Each COA covers
beta-glucan content, polysaccharides, heavy metals, pesticide residues, microbial counts, moisture,
and ash.

What are your lead times?

Standard 1–25 kg orders ship from our Newark, NJ warehouse within **2–3 weeks** of order
confirmation. Pallet orders (100+ kg): 4–6 weeks. Custom blend orders: contact us for timeline.

Do you ship internationally?

Yes. We ship to the EU, UK, Canada, Australia, Southeast Asia, and other major markets. Full export
documentation (COA, MSDS, import declaration support) is provided with all international orders.

# Making sure you're not a bot!

Loading...

You are seeing this because the administrator of this website has set up Anubis to protect the
server against the scourge of AI companies aggressively scraping websites. This can and does cause
downtime for the websites, which makes their resources inaccessible for everyone.

Anubis is a compromise. Anubis uses a Proof-of-Work scheme in the vein of Hashcash, a proposed
proof-of-work scheme for reducing email spam. The idea is that at individual scales the additional
load is ignorable, but at mass scraper levels it adds up and makes scraping much more expensive.

Ultimately, this is a placeholder solution so that more time can be spent on fingerprinting and
identifying headless browsers (EG: via how they do font rendering) so that the challenge proof of
work page doesn't need to be presented to users that are much more likely to be legitimate.

Please note that Anubis requires the use of modern JavaScript features that plugins like JShelter
will disable. Please disable JShelter or other such plugins for this domain.

Sadly, you must enable JavaScript to get past this challenge. This is required because AI companies
have changed the social contract around how website hosting works. A no-JS solution is a
work-in-progress.

Protected by [BotStopper][1] From [Techaro][2]. Made with ❤️ in 🇨🇦.

[1]: https://anubis.techaro.lol/docs/admin/botstopper
[2]: https://techaro.lol

FAQ

## Frequently Asked
## Questions

[View More][67]
Why source functional mushrooms from Canada?

Canada has some of the strictest agricultural and food safety regulations in the world. Buyers
choose Canadian suppliers for reliability, safety, and transparent oversight. Myzel ships
internationally and supports partners who want a clean, traceable supply chain. [Our sustainability
approach][68].

Do your mushroom powders undergo third party testing?

Yes. Every batch is tested by an independent laboratory for composition, safety, active compounds,
contaminants, and moisture. Separately, we also validate the identity of our mushroom cultures
through third-party DNA testing, so you can be confident every species is exactly what it’s labeled
as. [See our quality standards][69].

Are Certificates of Analysis available?

Yes. Every batch comes with a COA. Testing includes microbial testing, heavy metals, pathogens,
moisture, and water activity. [See our quality standards][70].

What species do you offer?

We supply 13 organic functional mushroom species: [Lion's Mane][71], [Reishi][72], [Chaga][73],
[Cordyceps][74], [Turkey Tail][75], [Shiitake][76], [Maitake][77], [Oyster][78], [King Oyster][79],
[Poria][80], [Beech][81], [Almond][82], and [Black Hoof][83]. [View all products][84].

Do you ship internationally?

Yes. We ship across North America and internationally, depending on regulatory requirements.

Do you offer custom blends?

Yes. Myzel produces custom mushroom blends in-house at our SQF certified facility, either to your
existing specification or with support from our team to develop a formulation suited to your
application. Every blend is produced under tight quality control and undergoes rigorous third-party
testing before fulfillment, with a COA included. MOQs apply. [Explore custom blending][85] or
[request a quote][86].
